description: Free market-signal pledge. It earns no credit now; a bounded non-transferable credit is released only if this same wallet later settles the named capability after it exists.

nonce.description: Optional unique alphanumeric nonce (8-128 chars) signed in the EIP-712 AgentAction message when HTTP x-agent-nonce header is not set.

signature.description: Optional EIP-712 AgentAction signature (action='demand_pledge') when HTTP x-agent-signature header is not set.

timestamp.description: Optional Unix timestamp in ms signed in the EIP-712 AgentAction message (within 5 minutes) when HTTP x-agent-timestamp header is not set.

wallet.description: Your Base wallet; must later be the x402 payer.

name: demand_pledge
title: Declare a capability you would pay for
